config.policy: Replace the entire prior 135 g frame plus 35 g compliance scope once. Retain P carrier 70 g, powered lift 62 g, plumbing 75 g, risers, roller, motor, transmission, driver, body interface and all other assembly rows. Pivot fasteners, carriage antirotation, rail screws/end stops, motor/end inserts, flexible hose and powered lift joints are not modeled.
